recovered_attempts.incident: Hydra rejected an nc_split_path override for ele-fashion, whose split is configured with node_split_path.
recovered_attempts.resolution: Use the dataset default split for ele-fashion; retain explicit fixed nc_split_path overrides for Movies and Grocery.

recovered_attempts.incident: Initial CUDA out-of-memory with 68.88 MiB free while another process held about 14.2 GiB on GPU 1.
recovered_attempts.resolution: Avoid constructing the unused basis state family during normal forwards; model function, hyperparameters, and split are unchanged.

recovered_attempts.incident: Initial AGD intervention path indexed anchored states during raw-space no-details inference.
recovered_attempts.resolution: Select raw states directly for interventions; reran 93-test suite and checkpoint analysis.

implementation_revision_note: After 36/54 completed cells, the forward path was made memory-efficient by computing only the state basis used by the selected variant during ordinary training. The recurrence and composition for that selected basis are unchanged; only the unused second state family was omitted. The failed ele-fashion/RU/seed42 cell and the remaining 17 cells then completed. Full pytest (93 passed), RU regression, and smoke checks passed after this change; no split or hyperparameter changed.
